slot_scores.name: missing_minimize_hours_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the goal to minimize the total hours worked across all four assigned tasks, or is there a different objective (such as minimizing the maximum hours for any single worker, or meeting a specific deadline)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the objective and specifically mentioned minimizing total hours, fully covering the hidden objective slot.

slot_scores.name: worker_at_most_one_task_constraint
slot_scores.evidence_quote: When assigning the four tasks to the four selected workers, is each worker allowed to perform at most one task, or can a single worker be assigned multiple tasks?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent directly asked whether each selected worker is limited to one task or may take multiple tasks, covering the exact hidden constraint.

stopping_behavior.rationale: Both P0 and P1 hidden slots were resolved by explicit questions before the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL.

summary: The agent asked focused questions that recovered both hidden slots: the minimization objective and the one-task-per-selected-worker constraint. It then stopped appropriately with no unresolved P0 or P1 issues.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
